name: Valuation Data 2
definition: Set of data which contains the link to the opening of the non deliverable trade and supplementary information on its valuation.

ValuationReference.name: Valuation Reference
ValuationReference.definition: Reference to the latest trade identification of the NDF opening trade.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Specifies the currency in which the non deliverable trade has to be settled ie the deliverable currency.

AdditionalValuationInformation.name: Additional Valuation Information
AdditionalValuationInformation.definition: Free format text that may contain information on the valuation such as the currency, the place, the time or the source of the rate.

SettlementParty.name: Settlement Party
SettlementParty.definition: Party through which the settlement will take place. It may contain the BIC of a central settlement system eg CLSBUS33.
